# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG**

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the opening range is narrow and price opens inside it, a pullback to VWAP with bullish ribbon alignment offers a mean-reversion edge. This captures intraday mean reversion after a tight open, using VWAP as dynamic support and EMA ribbon confirmation for trend alignment.

## Mechanism

Calculate opening range (OR) high/low from the first 5‑minute bar (09:30‑09:35 ET). If OR width < 0.2 × ATR(20) and the open price lies within the OR, then wait for price to retrace to within 0.1% of VWAP while the 8‑EMA > 21‑EMA > 55‑EMA (bullish ribbon) and the bar closes above VWAP; enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: chart‑stop at the OR low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5×ATR risk, runner trailed by 15% of highest‑since‑entry price. Regime filter: only trade when VIX < 15 and ADX < 20; avoid when ADX > 25 or VIX > 25.
